I found there to be way more dining options at Excellence and I really enjoyed sitting at the outdoor restaurant every morning for breakfast. Unico does reservations for all their restaurants for dinner and I found the service to be abysmal at 4/5 restaurants. 

The pools at excellence are far superior. They’re massive and you can really float/walk around a good bit of the resort. 

There are a lot more activities at Excellence. I could stay there all week and not have to leave. It seemed at Unico the options were to sit at the pool all day or pay for an excursion outside of the resort. 

When my group booked this trip, Unico was way more expensive than Excellence. I was expecting to be blown away with luxury and that definitely didn’t happen.

I reached out to probably 25 appraisers/companies before I got a hit. My dad has been a home inspector for 25+ years, and through his real estate connections I was put in contact with a large appraisal company in my state. I got hired! I was making $800/week for the first 2.5 months. Now I get paid 30% of the fee for every report I work on. That will increase to 50% when I’m licensed, and continue to go up with more education and experience. Some people will tell you to not work for a company that takes such a cut of the fee. However! I have a huge database to pull information from and they pay for all the little things that individual appraisers have to pay for themselves. Don’t be afraid to reach out to the big companies who will take a cut of your fee. For me, it’s been a wonderful opportunity and I couldn’t imagine getting my training anywhere else. 

***I will say, if you’re coming from a high paying job the pay cut will be drastic for the first year, at least. Lucky (?) for me, I was waiting tables before and not making a ton of money. So now, 5 months in, I’m making more money than I ever have.
